title: Google I/O 2011: Java Puzzlers - Scraping the Bottom of the Barrel
summary: Josh Bloch and Jeremy Manson present the eighth installment of Java Puzzlers at Google I/O 2011, a set of surprising corner cases in the Java language and libraries. It includes puzzlers on traps such as regular expression performance.
why: HN commenters recommend it as an entertaining tour of exotic Java corner cases.

quote.text: Java Puzzlers by Joshua Bloch and Jeremy Manson are pretty entertaining.
